system_prompt: You solve graph problems using only the explicitly supplied edges and rules. All node names are arbitrary identifiers; their meanings give no evidence about edges or roles. Return only a JSON object with one nonnegative integer field: {"answer": INTEGER}.
sampling_policy: Version-derived independent seeds; accept first structurally eligible candidate. No inference-based filtering. Four graphs per task/tier; reachability balanced 2 yes/2 no. Structural criteria are in frozen core.py.
conditions_policy: Original, byte-identical repeat, opaque-ID permutation and degree-reversed semantic names. Fixed graph/order/query per matched group. One map per rename condition; not an estimate over all possible names.
analysis_policy: Per model/task/tier counts and denominators: correct, wrong, invalid, length finish, missing, usage and costs. Original accuracy uses independent graphs; variant results remain paired, never independent n. Repeat-adjusted rename effects across all 72 graphs; 20,000 stratified graph bootstrap draws seed 20261108, 18 task/tier strata; two-sided exact McNemar for repeat vs each rename, Holm across 18 model/condition contrasts including missing tests. Incomplete coverage descriptive only; no complete-case headline comparison. Four graphs per task/tier is exploratory, not powered for small differences.
comparability: Same prompts/cap; native reasoning settings and hosted precision inherited unchanged. Tokenizers, reasoning labels and actual compute differ. Aliased hosted weights cannot be independently frozen. No aggregate ranking pooled with earlier studies.
